scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --external:better-sqlite3 --outfile=dist/index.js && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('.env')) { fs.copyFileSync('.env', 'dist/.env'); } else { console.warn('[build] no .env found - dist/.env not written; the packaged app will exit on launch without it'); } fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({type: 'commonjs'}))"
